evals.prompt: Fix a bug in this repository's parser: whitespace-only project names are currently accepted, but they must be rejected like empty names. Work through the fix end-to-end and run the relevant tests.
evals.expected_output: The agent adds and runs a focused regression test that reproduces the whitespace-only-name bug before changing the parser, confirms that the test fails for the expected reason, implements the smallest fix, reruns the test successfully, and keeps the test in the suite.
assertions: Adds the automated regression test before changing the parser implementation.
Runs the new test before the fix and confirms that it fails because whitespace-only names are accepted, not because of an unrelated setup error.
Changes the parser only after demonstrating the failing test, then reruns the same test and confirms that it passes.
Keeps the regression test in the test suite after the fix.

evals.prompt: Fix the release pipeline bug where an invalid manifest causes the script to delete the existing dist directory before validation fails. The last known-good artifacts must survive invalid input.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats pipeline configuration and scripts as part of the implementation: it first adds and runs a failing regression test proving that invalid input deletes the existing output, then changes the pipeline and confirms that the same test passes while preserving the prior artifacts.
assertions: Adds a regression test for validate-before-mutate behavior before changing the pipeline script or configuration responsible for the defect.
Runs the new test and confirms the expected destructive behavior before implementing the fix.
Does not interpret 'test first' as applying only to production source code.
Reruns the same test after the fix and confirms that invalid input preserves the last known-good output.

evals.prompt: Investigate why checkout totals sometimes differ by one cent, but do not change any files or implement a fix yet. I only want a diagnosis and a proposed next step.
evals.expected_output: The agent investigates without modifying files. It may propose a focused failing regression test as the first implementation step, but it does not claim that a test must be written or run during this diagnosis-only request.
assertions: Does not modify implementation or test files during the investigation-only request.
Distinguishes diagnosis from implementing a bug fix.
Proposes writing and confirming a failing regression test before any later implementation change.
